Can you name all 8 structures of the superior orbital fissure? 🧠 L F T S, then S A N I
Superior orbital fissure mnemonic: two codes, 4 + 4 = 8
Outside the ring: L F T S
L = Lacrimal nerve
F = Frontal nerve
T = Trochlear nerve
S = Superior ophthalmic vein
Inside the ring: S A N I
S = Superior division of the oculomotor nerve
A = Abducens nerve
N = Nasociliary nerve
I = Inferior division of the oculomotor nerve
Quick test: which one of the eight is the vein? Answer in the video.
Save this for your next anatomy exam.
Images: Gray's Anatomy (1918), Fig. 787, public domain; diagrams: Book Plume
